description: This is a FastAPI route module for managing bookings in a railway ticket booking system. It defines API endpoints for seat availability, seat locking, booking confirmation, retrieving user bookings, and retrieving individual bookings. The code interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models to perform operations such as querying seat inventory, locking seats, creating bookings, and loading bookings for a specific user.

methods.name: _refresh_locks(db: Session, schedule_id: int)
methods.description: Refreshes seat locks by releasing expired locks for a given schedule.

methods.name: SeatMapResponse availability(schedule_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a seat map with lock and booking status for a specific schedule.

methods.name: SeatMapResponse lock_seats(payload: LockSeatsRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Locks selected seats for a specified duration to allow a user to proceed with booking.

methods.name: BookingOut create_booking( payload: CreateBookingRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates a confirmed booking by converting locked seats into booked status and recording the booking details.

methods.name: List[BookingOut] my_bookings(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the list of bookings made by the current user.

methods.name: BookingOut get_booking(booking_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific booking by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.
